hook: Isolated *rain* possible in Telangana Tue-Wed, dry from Nov 26
hook_b: Isolated *rain* possible in Telangana Tue-Wed, dry from Nov 26
tldr: IMD forecasts light to moderate rain or thundershowers at isolated places in Telangana on Tuesday and Wednesday, with dry weather back from Nov 26.

beats.what: Hyderabad will see partly cloudy skies with morning mist or haze; max around 33°C, min 20°C Tuesday and 19°C Wednesday.
beats.why: A trough in easterlies over the Bay of Bengal to north-coastal Andhra Pradesh has become less marked.
beats.care: Morning mist can cut visibility on commutes; carry an umbrella just in case on Tue-Wed.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Monday was dry: city max 32.6°C, min 20.6°C, 76% humidity. Patancheru was coolest at 18.2°C.

cards.q: Will you carry an umbrella tomorrow?

qs: Will the morning mist slow traffic on ORR and highways?

facts.t: Patancheru was the coolest GHMC-map spot on Monday at *18.2°C*.

viz.verdict: A short wet window, then dry
Nights cool slightly through the week
